## Authority and failure

- [ ] Project/job/revision scope is server-owned and verified.
- [ ] Tool input, budget, timeout, cancellation, and idempotency are bounded.
- [ ] Denial and failure cannot be reported as success.
- [ ] No raw production or cross-tenant secret enters a worker workspace.
- [ ] Replaced code is removed, or its authority and removal trigger are documented.
